title: Effectiveness of Diaphragmatic Breathing on Reflux Symptoms in Outpatients
brief_summary: Researchers are trying to determine if abdominal breathing exercises can reduce symptoms associated with GERD (Gastroesophageal reflux disease).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults with complaints of GERD, reflux, and/or heartburn symptoms

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
